title: Boeing ransomware claim by INC Ransom, Nov 20, 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Boeing, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: The group claims 3.6 million files from one Boeing-linked support unit. None of it is verified, and Boeing has not said whether anything was taken.
who_is_affected: No one is confirmed to be affected. If the claim is true, it could involve staff, vendors and customers of one military helicopter support unit.

known.text: INC Ransom listed Boeing on its leak site on Nov 20. This confirms the post exists, not that data was taken.
Boeing has made no public statement about the claim as of Nov 20.
Boeing has filed no cybersecurity 8-K as of Nov 20.

not_known.text: Whether any intrusion happened, and at which Boeing or joint-venture system.
Whether the files and screenshots are real.
Whether the unit is part of Boeing's own network.
Whether Boeing will make a statement or file with the SEC.
Whether the group will publish more data.
